Dedup: none of the 90 open objectui issues names `DatasourceResourcePage` with `Select…`, `ConfigFieldRenderer`'s placeholder, or `SettingsField`'s placeholder. objectui#11220 (PR objectui#11250) fixed the flow-screen site of the same literal and is the family's precedent.

## The sites (objectui `origin/main`)

| site | reach |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx` (about `:484`), an `enum` driver-config property renders `SelectValue placeholder="Select…"` | **a named producer.** The config form is built from the driver catalog's `configSchema` (`GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers`, `service-datasource` `driver-catalog.ts` → `getDriverConfigJsonSchemaById`). At objectstack `origin/main`, `TursoConfigSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/driver/turso.zod.ts`, about `:318`–`:498`) declares `mode: TursoTransportModeSchema.optional()` (`:497`), a `z.enum(['local', 'replica', 'remote'])`. A Turso datasource with no `mode` shows `Select…` under every locale. Read at source; not rendered in a browser |
| `packages/components/src/custom/config-field-renderer.tsx` (about `:138`), `field.placeholder ?? 'Select…'` | zero measured in-repo reach: the objectui#11220 dev's runtime probe found every in-tree dashboard select carries a `defaultValue`. It is a public export of `@object-ui/components`, so a downstream default-less select would reach it |
| `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` (about `:455`), `SelectValue placeholder="Select…"` | zero measured reach: the objectui#11220 dev read the objectstack service-settings manifests, and every closed `type: 'select'` declares a default. The one without a default declares `valueDomain` and renders `DomainCombobox` |

## The route (for triage, not a ruling)

- Each site has an existing key, so no new literal list is needed:
  - Studio's own table carries `engine.form.selectEllipsis` in en (`Select…`) and zh (`请选择…`) (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts` about `:1988` / `:4916`), read today by `SchemaForm` and `InspectorComboField`.
  - `@object-ui/i18n` carries `common.select` in every built-in pack, which PR objectui#11250 reuses.
  - `@object-ui/components` already declares `@object-ui/i18n`, and its sibling `config-panel-renderer` uses `createSafeTranslation`, so no new dependency edge is needed.
- Pins:
  - under zh, the Turso `mode` select with no value shows the localized word;
  - an authored or default value renders as before (the control);
  - one enumeration pin: product source (not tests or comments) carries no hard-coded `Select…` placeholder once the family closes.
